facts: Procedure text still says Start firmware upgrade, but item requires older BIOS downgrade.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL using same generic update assumption.
source_snapshot.v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE with downgrade support, backup and recovery.

original_test_intent.statement: Deliberately install an approved older BIOS and prove downgrade support, target version, preserved configuration and healthy host recovery.
must_preserve: Downgrade direction and older target, not a normal upgrade.
unknowns: Anti-rollback/minimum version, intermediate path, config schema compatibility, activation and recovery.

v2_review_conclusion.specific_gap: It needs explicit anti-rollback/lowest-supported-version evidence and treatment of settings schema/security state across rollback.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Downgrade is gated by vendor-supported version path, security/anti-rollback policy and recoverable configuration migration; an upload-capable UI is not proof of support.

revision_candidate.test_name: Downgrade Host BIOS Through the Approved Version Path
revision_candidate.purpose: Install the exact approved older BIOS on the mapped host and verify supported rollback, intended settings/security state, successful POST/boot and complete device health.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: Exact board/BMC/current-BIOS combination whose vendor matrix supports the requested older version/path.
revision_candidate.target_scope: One host BIOS and an ordered signed image manifest containing the final older image and every required intermediate version; other firmware excluded.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Current/target/minimum supported versions, anti-rollback policy, ordered version path, and for every hop: component ID, image filename/version/provenance/hash/signature/compatibility, vendor method/parameters, activation/reboot rule, expected active version, POST/boot/config/Secure Boot/TPM/boot-key/device-health gate and explicit approval before the next transition; plus backup and recovery.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Read version/support metadata first. If downgrade is explicitly allowed, freeze the ordered manifest and back up configuration. For each hop in order, reverify component and that hop's image/hash/signature/compatibility, use only the vendor method, monitor its task, perform the approved activation, then require the declared active version plus POST, boot, configuration, security and complete device-health gate before seeking approval for the next hop. Stop the path on any failure.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Stable power, console/OOB, recovery image/dual-bank method and data/boot-key risk accepted.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Vendor downgrade support/path; ordered per-hop manifest and approvals; for every image, component/version/provenance/hash/signature/compatibility, update task/messages, activation and verified active version; per-hop POST/boot/config/Secure Boot/TPM/boot-order/device inventory and SEL/kernel health; final recovery state.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: Every approved manifest hop completes in order and passes its active-version, POST/boot, configuration, security and device-health gate before the next; the exact final older version is reached with healthy host. Skipped hops, forced bypass or final version string alone fail.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Do not disable signature/anti-rollback, force unsupported image, assume preserve-all compatibility, interrupt power, retry automatically or clear evidence.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: BIOS/security/platform owners approve rollback path and recovery.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Agent may automate supported path; recovery/security disposition remains human.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: On rejection/POST failure preserve task/logs and use approved recovery or return to known-good BIOS.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Missing or unordered per-hop manifest/approval, unsupported target/path, anti-rollback rejection, any hop's signature/component/compatibility mismatch, power/task error, failed activation/version, lost keys/settings, POST/boot/device regression or no recovery.

identified_defects: Procedure language says upgrade despite downgrade intent.
Anti-rollback/version path and security state absent.
reason_for_change: A BIOS downgrade can be rejected or change configuration/security semantics even when image upload succeeds; V3 treats version-path support as a precondition.

new_technical_evidence.title: DMTF Redfish Resource and Schema Guide — SoftwareInventory
new_technical_evidence.supports: SoftwareInventory may expose LowestSupportedVersion and component-specific SoftwareId/RelatedItem; these are evidence inputs, not universal permission to downgrade.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: Vendor anti-rollback and intermediate path remain authoritative.

objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 adds minimum-version, anti-rollback, intermediate-path and security/configuration migration gates unique to downgrade rather than treating it as an ordinary firmware upload.

agent_understanding_result.notes: Initial validator found singular-image wording incompatible with intermediate downgrade hops. Revalidation confirmed the ordered per-image manifest, per-hop identity/integrity/activation/security/health gates and approval before advancing.
